---
title: "Gating"
---

Automated gating with the openCyto framework.

## `sw_gate_template` {#sw_gate_template}

Build a gating template CSV.

### Usage

```r
sw_gate_template(output_file, template_type = "lymphocyte",
                 debris_min, singlet_wider_gate,
                 flowclust_k, flowclust_target, pool_samples)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `output_file` | Path for the output CSV file. |
| `template_type` | Template type: `"lymphocyte"`, `"myeloid"`, `"nk"`, `"treg"`, `"full_pbmc"`. |
| `debris_min` | Required. Lower FSC-A cutoff (`min` of the mindensity debris gate). |
| `singlet_wider_gate` | Required. `wider_gate` of the singletGate method. |
| `flowclust_k` | Required for `"lymphocyte"` and `"treg"`. Number of flowClust clusters `K`. |
| `flowclust_target` | Required for `"lymphocyte"` and `"treg"`. flowClust `target` cluster index. |
| `pool_samples` | Required. `TRUE` pools all samples to fit one gate; `FALSE` fits a gate per sample (`collapseDataForGating`). |

### Details

Writes a default CSV gating template suitable for a standard lymphocyte panel.
The template follows the openCyto CSV format and can be edited before use.
Includes gating strategies for singlets (FSC-A vs FSC-H), live cells
(viability dye negative), and lymphocytes (FSC-A vs SSC-A).

### Value

The file path (invisibly).

---

## `sw_gate_run` {#sw_gate_run}

Apply automated gating.

### Usage

```r
sw_gate_run(fcs_files, gating_template, transform_channels = NULL,
        transform_func = NULL, cofactor)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fcs_files` | Character vector of FCS file paths or a `flowSet`. |
| `gating_template` | Path to a CSV gating template. |
| `transform_channels` | Optional character vector of channels to transform before gating. |
| `transform_func` | Optional transformation function. |
| `cofactor` | No default. arcsinh cofactor; required when `transform_channels` is set without `transform_func`. |

### Details

Full openCyto gating workflow: loads FCS files into a GatingSet, applies
optional transformation, and runs hierarchical gating using a CSV template.

### Value

A `GatingSet` object with gates applied.

---

## `sw_gate_extract` {#sw_gate_extract}

Extract gated populations.

### Usage

```r
sw_gate_extract(gs, node)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `gs` | A `GatingSet`. |
| `node` | Character string specifying the gate node to extract. |

### Details

Extracts `flowFrame` objects from a specific gate node of a `GatingSet`.

### Value

A named list of `flowFrame` objects, one per sample in the GatingSet.

## `sw_clean_run` {#sw_clean_run}

Clean spectral flow data: margins, arcsinh, PeacoQC, then debris, singlet and live gates.

### Usage

```r
sw_clean_run(
  x, debris_window, singlet_wider_gate, pool_samples,
  viability_channel, viability_method, viability_cut,
  IT_limit, MAD, cofactor
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | FCS file paths, a `flowFrame`, a `flowSet` or a list of `flowFrame`s. |
| `debris_window` | Required, no default. Lower and upper FSC-A limit (raw scale) of the events the nonDebris density is built from. openCyto drops events outside [min, max] before it looks for peaks and valleys, so the cut is a valley of the density of the events inside the window and lies inside it. Events below the cut are debris. Events above max are kept. If the window holds one peak or no valley, the cut falls on the lowest event in the window (a warning, and `cut_at_window_floor = TRUE` in `$gates`). Benchmark 05 used c(2e5, 1.5e6) with mindensity (reference only). |
| `singlet_wider_gate` | Required, no default. Width of the openCyto singletGate on FSC-A against FSC-H. TRUE widens it and keeps more events near the edge. Benchmark 05 used TRUE (reference only). |
| `pool_samples` | Required, no default. TRUE fits each gate once on the pooled events of all samples and applies it to every sample. FALSE fits one gate per sample. Benchmark 05 used TRUE (gates pooled over donors) (reference only). |
| `viability_channel` | Required, no default. Channel of the viability dye. Dead cells are the high tail. Benchmark 05 used "LIVE DEAD NIR-A" (reference only). |
| `viability_method` | Required, no default. How the live cut is found: "mindensity" takes the valley of the density, "boundary" takes the fixed cut in viability_cut. Benchmark 05 used "mindensity" (reference only). |
| `viability_cut` | Required, no default. Live cut on the arcsinh scale for viability_method = "boundary" (events below it are live). Must be NULL for "mindensity". Benchmark 05 used NULL (mindensity finds the valley) (reference only). |
| `IT_limit` | Required, no default. Isolation Tree limit of PeacoQC. It trades stringency against the number of events kept. Benchmark 05 used 0.55 (reference only). |
| `MAD` | Required, no default. Median Absolute Deviation limit of PeacoQC. It trades stringency against the number of events kept. Benchmark 05 used 6 (reference only). |
| `cofactor` | Required, no default. Divisor of the arcsinh transformation of all fluorescence channels, asinh(x / cofactor). Scatter stays raw. It shifts the QC and viability cuts. Benchmark 05 used 6000 (reference only). |

### Details

Steps run in this order: `sw_filter_margins_peacoqc()` on the raw scale, arcsinh on all fluorescence channels (`sw_transform_apply()`), `sw_qc_batch()` with the given `IT_limit` and `MAD`, then `sw_gate_run()` with a template of three gates: `nonDebris`, `singlets`, `live`. Scatter channels stay raw, so `debris_window` is in raw FSC-A units. Nothing runs after the live gate.

The margin step removes the events at the observed minimum and maximum of every scatter and fluorescence channel of each sample (PeacoQC `RemoveMargins()` compares strictly against `min(e)` and `max(e)`), not only events on the instrument range limit. The `margins` row of `$audit` shows how many events it removed.

If any required argument is missing, the function stops once. The message names every missing argument with what it controls, how to choose it, and the benchmark 05 value labelled "not a recommendation". No step runs first. A sample with no events left after a step stops the run.

### Value

A list: `events` (live singlet flowFrames, arcsinh scale), `audit` (per sample and step: `n_events`, `n_removed`, percentages), `audit_total`, `gates` (per sample and gate, with `cut_at_window_floor` for the `nonDebris` rows), `qc` (PeacoQC summary with the limits used), `template` and `parameters`.
